title: Quality Products and a Super Fun Box
text: I am thrilled with my Russia Box! A small box, but one filled to the brim with delights (not just from Russia, but also Ukraine, Lithuania, and many other Eastern countries).  I love re-experiencing the time I spent in Ukraine through these candies and chocolates, and I'm very happy with the surprise gift in every box that I can use to decorate my living spaces.
label: positive
